rationale: The plan matches the reference on every point: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts for an unpaired 6v6 single-batch design, blind-VST PCA and distance heatmap with library sizes and an explicit retain-unless-outlier policy for sample_01, internal median-of-ratios normalization, ~condition with chow as reference and a named HFD-vs-chow contrast, apeglm shrinkage with BH at 0.05 and independent filtering on. The pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, tied to the smallest group) is minimal and justified. Enrichment correctly uses the mouse MSigDB Hallmark (MH 2026.1) collection with fgsea preranked on the full Wald-statistic-ranked list and a 15-500 size window, avoiding the human-set-on-mouse-symbols error. The report step specifies versions, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, NA provenance, and design caveats.
